newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: IMF technical team expected soon in Venezuela.
newsitem.headline: IMF technical team expected soon in Venezuela.

text.p: An International Monetary Fund technical mission will be in Venezuela from about Jan. 20 to review with the government fiscal, monetary and foreign exchange policies and targets, press reports said.
Issues to be discussed, one official source quoted by the daily El Universal said, included whether Venezuela should apply for an extended IMF fund facility.

Finance Minister Luis Raul Matos Azocar said last month the government had not yet defined "the terms of any future extended fund facility", which is used to back long-term reforms, typically over three years.

After initiating an IMF-backed adjustment program in April, Venezuela signed a stand-by agreement with the IMF in July. It received a first installment of $500 million but decided not to use the remainder of the $1.4 billion IMF stand-by loan.
